Problem Statement:
Given an array of integers, determine its length using Java's inbuilt function. 
Input Description:
The first line contains an integer N, the number of elements in the array.
The second line contains N space-separated integers. 
Output Description:
Print the length of the array using an inbuilt function. 
Sample Input:
5
3 1 4 1 5 
Sample Output:
5
